slo_description: 95% of 1-minute windows meet the 300ms p99 latency objective over a 30-day rolling window
calculation_description: Share of 1-minute windows whose p99 latency was at or under the 300ms objective, across all requests over the budget period. All windows weighted equally.

method_descriptions.all_windows_p99: Every 1-minute window counts equally against the p99 objective. Current standard methodology.
method_descriptions.weighted_by_traffic: Low-traffic windows (2am-6am) are down-weighted relative to peak windows.
method_descriptions.exclude_planned_spikes: Excludes windows overlapping approved load-test/marketing spikes.

team_incentive: Bonus pool released if attainment > 95% at end of the current period
methodology_change_policy: Method change requires Architecture Review Board approval per SRE handbook Section 8.4
note: Attainment is short of target this period, driven by elevated p99 during a traffic surge and the nightly reconciliation batch window.
